focus: Dweller invite/follow/arrest flow: DungeonDwellers.cs, Dialog_LeaveDungeon.cs changes, DungeonSite.TryMovePawnOut / DungeonExit.MoveArrivedOut changes
diffSource: since build 39 (2026-10-10T07:54:56Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: A downed follower ticked in the Capture section is silently left behind
findings.detail: AllSendablePawns(allowCapturableDownedPawns: true) lists a downed factionless follower, and AddPawnsSections shows it under CaptureSection. In TryAccept it still passes IsFollower, so it is removed from `pawns` and from leftToLoad. SendThroughExit then returns early because it is Downed, so nobody carries it and the player gets no message. Change the follower filter in TryAccept to `p => DungeonDwellerUtility.IsFollower(p) && !p.Downed && !p.InMentalState` so a downed follower goes through the normal haul path. Add `!p.InMentalState` to the Recache follower loop too, to match vanilla's allowEvenIfInMentalState: false.

findings.title: followers/refused keep dead or destroyed pawns, so saves hold references that can't be resolved
findings.detail: Nothing removes a follower or refused dweller who dies or whose body is destroyed. Saving a LookMode.Reference to a discarded pawn makes the game log a warning on load, which the PostLoadInit null removal hides but does not prevent. In ExposeData, when Scribe.mode == LoadSaveMode.Saving, remove pawns that are Destroyed or Dead from both lists before the Scribe_Collections calls.

findings.title: Square-bracket pawn tokens in four new Keyed strings will show literally in-game
findings.detail: TUBAD_Invite_Accepted ([PAWN_objective]), TUBAD_Arrested ([PAWN_objective] twice), TUBAD_Dweller_Joined_Text ([PAWN_pronoun]) and TUBAD_Dweller_Left ([PAWN_possessive]) use square brackets. Square brackets are only filled in when a string goes through AdjustedFor (the grammar resolver), and no file under Source/ calls AdjustedFor. Every call site in DungeonDwellers.cs (lines 47, 93-94, 98, 229) runs .Translate(dweller.Named("PAWN")). That goes through GrammarResolverSimple.TryResolveInner, which only looks for '{' and copies every other character as it is. So players will read things like 'Mark [PAWN_objective] in the leave dialog'. Nothing throws and nothing is logged. The fix is to write the tokens with braces: {PAWN_objective}, {PAWN_pronoun}, {PAWN_possessive}. The same strings already use {PAWN_nameDef} that way. Formatted() calls CapitalizeSentences, so {PAWN_pronoun} at the start of a sentence in Joined_Text will be capitalised.

findings.title: Vanilla's 'Try to arrest' still shows on dwellers next to 'Arrest here'
findings.detail: Vanilla's arrest option returns an option for any pawn that CanBeArrestedBy allows. With no prison bed, clicking it only shows 'CannotArrest: NoPrisonerBed', so players see two arrest entries on a dweller and one of them does nothing useful. Not a bug.

findings.title: Invite chance clamp (5% to 95%) does not match the 0 to 100% settings slider
findings.detail: InviteChance clamps to 0.05..0.95, but Mod.cs lets inviteChance go from 0 to 1 and the settings label shows the raw value. At either end the setting and the chance in the float menu disagree.

findings.title: A follower whose walk to the exit is interrupted is lost when the last colonist leaves
findings.detail: SendThroughExit removes the follower from its lord before starting EnterPortal. If that job fails (damage, a constant-think-tree flee), the dweller is left without a lord and still listed as a follower. ShouldRemoveMapNow then removes the map once no player humanlike remains, and the follower is never resolved and no message is shown. Uncommon, since followers usually arrive while the party is still hauling.

findings.title: InviteChance description does not mention the 5%-95% clamp
findings.detail: TUBAD_Settings_InviteChance_Desc says the setting is multiplied by the inviter's social impact. InviteChance also clamps the result to 0.05-0.95, so a slider at 0% or 100% does not give a 0% or 100% chance. The description could say so.
